preconditions.description: T is a positive integer representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer representing the number of stones per player.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and all(c.islower() for c in A) for A, N in zip(A_list, N_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, A is a string of length N containing only lowercase alphabets.

preconditions.expression: all(len(B) == N and all(c.islower() for c in B) for B, N in zip(B_list, N_list))
preconditions.description: For each test case, B is a string of length N containing only lowercase alphabets.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == 2 * N and all(c.islower() for c in line) for line, N in zip(output_lines, N_list))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a string of length 2*N containing only lowercase alphabets.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(line) == sorted(A + B) for line, A, B in zip(output_lines, A_list, B_list))
postconditions.description: Each output string is a permutation of the combined multiset of stones from Alice and Bob.

postconditions.expression: all(is_optimal_game_result(line, A, B) for line, A, B in zip(output_lines, A_list, B_list))
postconditions.description: Each output string represents the result of the game where Alice minimizes and Bob maximizes the lexicographical value of S, playing optimally with full information.
